decisions.summary: dev-based Git-Flow: main is protected/production, receives merges only from dev; never commit to main directly.
All new work branches off dev; feature PRs target dev only; dev-to-main merges happen only on explicit user request.
resources/ is local and gitignored; importers read staged canonical packages under resources/import-sources/, never raw upstream folders.
Planning artifacts (specs/<feature>/, docs/feature-*/, Backend/report/feature-*/) are deleted by their own feature in its last commit before merge.
Deletion commit comes after engineering review passes, never before; it is pure deletion (README amendments land with the work).
Per-file fold gate: fact not recoverable from code/tests/README goes into nearest README proved with a file:LINE; repoint every inbound reference first.
Evidence worth keeping becomes a test that fails on drift, not a report; homeless assertions are recorded in docs/TESTING_DEBT.md.
Long-lived documentation is a closed list: READMEs, law files, .architecture/**, docs/contracts/**, docs/TESTING_DEBT.md, .claude/.agents/.specify; everything else dies with its feature.
Steady-state contract truth is code + nearest README, indexed by the thin pointer layer docs/contracts/; specs/<feature>/contracts/ are planning-time only.
Read the nearest README before changing a folder; a change that alters documented behavior updates that README in the same change.
Comments forbidden by default; a comment may exist only when non-derivable, harm-preventing, and unsolvable by rename/restructure/README; burden of proof on the comment.
Comment rule scope: Backend .cs in api/application/domain/infrastructure and Frontend src/ .ts/.html/.scss only; tests, scripts, tooling, generated files out of scope; boundary is part of the rule.
Tool/compiler directives (#pragma, eslint-disable, @ts-ignore, prettier-ignore, /*! */) are not comments and are never removed.
Every change deletes offending comments in the area it touches, in the same commit; no separate cleanup pass or backlog.
Clean-code-guard pack is reference material only; project rules override it (I-prefixed interfaces, ApiResponse contract, root comment rule stricter than the pack).
Tests assert behavior not implementation; mocks target real boundaries; real DTOs constructed not mocked; persistence tests use real infrastructure; Quranic test data source-safe.
Narrowest meaningful gate first; broad gates once at milestone/review/pre-PR; no tail-piping; no concurrent PostgreSQL test processes; report exact gate/command/result/cleanup.
Arabic-first RTL scholarly-calm product; read PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md before UI work; avoid generic SaaS, kitschy religious decor, gamified UI, enterprise greige.
Currently 'None'; an opening feature records slug/plan/decision-record here and clears it in its own deletion commit.
C#/.NET keeps I-prefixed interface names, overriding the generic clean-code no-I-prefix rule.
At the API boundary the ApiResponse contract and API_GUIDELINES.md are authoritative; exceptions-over-return-codes applies inside layers only.
Never invent Quran text, tafsir, translations, morphology, gates, or religious content; never silently modify source data; keep traceability to source files.
Every data processor/importer/generator must produce a report with totals, missing records, duplicates, warnings, and validation result.
Every implementation summary reports changed files, build status, test status, validation/report path, and skipped/uncertain items.
Single source of truth for test selection and gates; the six entrypoint law files carry only short policy and defer here; on conflict this file controls selection.
Never record a test count, file count, pass total, or measured duration as a standing fact in prose; run the command and read the number.

decisions.summary: Selection is by lane, never a hand-written --filter or ad-hoc glob; Backend lanes resolve via test-gates.tsv, Frontend lanes via angular.json configurations.

decisions.section: §3.1 The catalog is the selection contract

decisions.section: §3.3 One database server at a time
decisions.summary: All DB fixtures lease one shared postgres:16-alpine runtime behind a cross-process OS lock; two Backend test processes must never run concurrently.
SmokeDataReadTests takes an exclusive postgres:18 server (18 pg_dump vs 16 pg_restore); lanes selecting it alongside others split into two sequential shards.
Missing canonical resources fail a runner-launched lane at preflight rather than silently skipping; in-test gates self-skip only for runs started outside the runner.
Any migration invalidates the canonical smoke dump; regenerate with create-smoke-dump --yes in the same change.
Any change touching Backend/api routes, contracts, auth, middleware, or binding requires the smoke lane, plus a matching SmokeRouteCatalog entry in the same change (bidirectional parity).
There is no CI; .github/workflows/ does not exist; every gate is local and human/agent-executed; 'CI is green' is never available as evidence.
The npm test script owns the two-fork Vitest cap and run timeout; a direct ng test invocation bypasses both and is not a lane.
Never cite root 'npx tsc --noEmit': root tsconfig is files:[] plus project references and --noEmit does not follow references, so it type-checks nothing.
Frontend pre-PR order: check:permission-catalogue, check:audit-action-types, typecheck, build:verify, test:full.
Playwright E2E is an opt-in local gate, never required pre-PR or for release; it never substitutes for the backend route-smoke gate.
*.e2e.ts naming is load-bearing: the Vitest builder globs from src/ and cannot see e2e/, Playwright matches only .e2e.ts — a .spec.ts under e2e/ is run by nothing.
Abwab E2E specs write to the local dev DB via per-test sandbox sections; archived residue is permanent and accepted; live e2e-sandbox residue is a teardown bug.
The Abwab Playwright project runs single-worker: a Global-scope reorder resequences shared rows and 2 workers produced a measured wrong-result race.
Deleting a test requires documented obsolete/redundant proof and named replacement coverage.
pre-pr runs the full Backend suite exactly once as two complementary shards, always building once; it is deliberately not composed from the overlapping focused lanes.
A Backend-only change with no frontend/generated-contract diff runs no Frontend tests.
Official identity is flat parchment + single scholarly green; the navy+gold Real Pages prototype is superseded, its surviving reference values recorded in UI_STYLE_SYSTEM.md §15.
Dark theme deliberately still runs interim navy+gold values; full reconciliation to green is a deferred later task.
Green appears on no more than ~10% of any screen; one primary action per view; navy is footer-only and never an accent.
Green may appear only in the 9 locked list entries; everything else stays banned as solid green; list authoritative here, mirrored into UI_STYLE_SYSTEM.md §16.3.

Quran/Mushaf faces (Amiri + ayah-marker face) are sacred and stable: never change Quran glyph fonts or rendering, never animate Quran text.
